action_classifications.description: List channels/DMs, or fetch one channel's info when `channel` is provided. Returns a channels[] array for consistent shape.
Retrieve messages from a channel, DM, or MPIM.
Retrieve reply messages in a thread.
List the user IDs that are members of a conversation.
Create a new public or private channel.
Archive (archived=true) or unarchive (archived=false) a channel.
Update a channel's name, topic, and/or description in one call.
Join an existing channel.
Leave a channel.
Invite one or more users to a channel.
Remove a user from a channel.
Set the read cursor for a conversation.
Send a message to a channel, DM, or thread. Posts as the authenticated user by default; pass `as_bot: true` to post as the app.
Edit an existing message's text or blocks.
Delete a message.
Retrieve a permalink URL for a specific message.
List all members of the workspace.
Fetch a Slack user by user ID or email.
Update the authenticated user's status text, emoji, or other profile fields.
Add an emoji reaction to a message.
Remove an emoji reaction from a message or file.
List files uploaded to the workspace.
Get info about a file and its comments.
Delete a file from the workspace.
Initiate a file upload and complete registration (returns upload URL).
Pin a message to a channel.
Remove a pinned message from a channel.
List pinned items in a channel.
Add a bookmark to a channel.
Edit an existing channel bookmark.
Remove a bookmark from a channel.
List bookmarks in a channel.
Search messages across the workspace (requires user token).
Search files across the workspace (requires user token).
Combined search across messages + files.
List all user groups in the workspace.
Create a new user group.
Update an existing user group.
List the members of a user group.
Replace the member list of a user group.
Verify authentication, return workspace + user identity.
Get workspace (team) info.
List all custom emojis in the workspace.

properties.name: aliases
properties.description: Other ids this channel has had (for example the original channel id in an imported export), used to resolve old permalinks

properties.name: ts
properties.description: Slack message timestamp, unique within the channel

properties.name: threadTs
properties.description: Timestamp of the thread parent, when this is a reply

properties.name: botId
properties.description: Slack bot id when the message was posted by a bot or app; bot messages never produce decisions

properties.name: email
properties.description: Email (needs users:read.email), used for identity matching

properties.name: ok
properties.description: Slack 'ok' flag — true if the operation succeeded.

properties.name: url
properties.description: The URL of the authenticated workspace (e.g. 'https://myteam.slack.com/').

properties.name: user_id
properties.description: Encoded ID of the authenticated user.

properties.name: bot_id
properties.description: Encoded ID of the bot, present when the token belongs to a bot user.

properties.name: is_enterprise_install
properties.description: True if the app is installed on an enterprise grid.

properties.name: messages[].reply_count
properties.description: Number of replies (only on the parent message).

properties.name: has_more
properties.description: True if there are more replies beyond this page.

properties.name: ok
properties.description: Slack 'ok' flag. True if the read cursor was successfully updated.

properties.name: usergroups[].team_id
properties.description: Team that the user group belongs to.

properties.name: usergroups[].auto_type
properties.description: Indicates if the group is auto-managed (e.g. 'admin', 'owner').

properties.name: usergroups[].user_count
properties.description: Number of members (only present when include_count=true).

properties.name: usergroup.team_id
properties.description: Team the user group belongs to.

properties.name: has_more
properties.description: True if there are more messages beyond this page.

properties.name: ok
properties.description: Whether the API call was successful.
